title: The Council of Ephesus opens
summary: The third ecumenical council opened at Ephesus and condemned Nestorius, archbishop of Constantinople, affirming Mary as Theotokos, mother of God.
reason: Nestorius and Cyril of Alexandria were locked in a bitter dispute over how the divine and human natures are united in Christ.
significance: It led to the separation of the Church of the East, which spread Christianity across Asia.
